motivation: v4 prefix-conditioned direct long-horizon queries beat persistence but retain mean Eu .4011/Ep .5684; short horizons are more accurate. Test a time-local state update and own-prediction rollout without changing the requested full horizon.
time_units: solver units, not confirmed SI seconds
training_data_access: True previous/current states from TRAIN trajectories only. Cycle through all 238 training transitions per case; optional four-step training uses own predictions after first two true inputs.
validation_data_access: Only the same two frozen prefix frames initialize rollout. All 238 later inputs are own predictions; references are used exclusively by the scorer. No teacher-forced future validation input.
representation: Time-local coordinate/Fourier PINN; learned correction to linear two-state extrapolation. Hard IC at local t0; local time0..dt; PDE derivatives physical, viscosity1/Re.
loss: Data MSE normalized by train-only field std times .05 in both phases; physical NS residual plus approximate obstacle no-slip. No crop-wall loss.
training_phases: 40k sampled one-step updates, then initialize from best full-rollout checkpoint and do10k four-step full-grid updates; PDE/BC at first interval of each sampled window; all targets train-only.
selection: Full own-prediction 238-step validation, equal mean of per-frame Eu/Ep per scenario then equal average of six scenarios. No final test.
stability: Stop a rollout if nonfinite or abs signal exceeds1000; report divergence and prospective score penalty1e6. Never clip or drop failed cases from mean.
output_constraints: Each predicted pressure is centered using its OWN fluid values; known solid cells zeroed. No reference future statistics.
latency: Whole GPU step includes current/previous feature rebuild, low-resolution pooling, encoder, field prediction, pressure gauge and solid mask;3x200 timings plus actual-rollout step distributions. Initial tensors/grid on GPU; no rendering.
unchanged: 69train/6validation,36/3geometries; original frozen775/160/169 split; same prefix2/3 and future targets4..241 asv4; full1024x256 grid; main test sealed.
data_cache: Read-only originals rehashed on CPU; training trajectories temporarily float32 on GPU with per-frame own pressure gauge and solid mask. Validation GPU receives prefix only, future arrays stay with scorer on CPU. No new CFD/download/local bulk data.
smoke: Subset one train/one val;3one-step+2four-step updates; active PDE; full238-step causal validation and timings before main phase. Smoke is functionality evidence only.
limitations: Development comparison changes model dynamics/training; not an isolated proof of the cause of v4 errors
Data-assisted PINN on cropped fields, not a full-domain physics-only solver
No LLM comparison, multiple-seed confirmation or final-test evidence yet
